title: Injective coordinates for a localized triangular monic quotient
statement: For fields k,K with a k-algebra structure, algebraically independent x:Fin d→K, any finite b:Fin m→K, nonzero h, monic triangular p_i of natDegree e_i, and y assigning x, inverse h(x) and b, assume every displayed triangular equation evaluates to zero. Then the quotient of k[X,T,Y] by the ideal of the displayed equations has an injective k-linear coordinate map to functions on exponent tuples a:(i:Fin m)→Fin(e_i), with values in k(x). Evaluation of any polynomial q is the sum of its quotient coordinates times the products of b_i to the bounded exponents. No independence, algebraicity or spanning of b is assumed.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07BV, first assertion, triangular minimal polynomials and denominator clearing; Tag 08JZ, localization presentation. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ because the local literature checkout is absent.

proof.text: Construct g:k[X]→k(x) using the algebraic-independence equivalence from its fraction field. Its injectivity and h≠0 make g(h) a unit. Extend g to f:D→k(x) with IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom. The localization injectivity criterion and injectivity of g prove f injective. Its composite with k(x)→K agrees with aeval x on k[X].
Apply localized normal form with phi equal to the composite D→k(x)→K, obtaining a linear equivalence nf from the quotient to exponent-indexed D-coefficients and its evaluation formula.

Compose nf with the pointwise k-linear map induced by f. If two images are equal, apply injectivity of f at each exponent and injectivity of nf. The evaluation formula becomes the desired one because the intermediate-field scalar action on K is multiplication by its inclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModel_normal_form
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → K) (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k x)
    (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (y : Fin (d + 1 + m) → K) (e : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hh : h ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic) (he : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = e i)
    (hyx : ∀ j : Fin d, y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ = x j)
    (hyt : y ⟨d, by omega⟩ = (MvPolynomial.aeval x h)⁻¹)
    (hyb : ∀ i : Fin m, y ⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ = b i)
    (hzero : ∀ q ∈ triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p,
      MvPolynomial.aeval y q = 0)
    : ∃ coord :
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)) →ₗ[k]
        (((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)) → IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range x)),
      Function.Injective coord ∧
      ∀ q : MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k,
        MvPolynomial.aeval y q =
          ∑ a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)),
            coord (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q) a • (∏ i, b i ^ (a i).val)
